title: A dataset-specific model identifies features associated with reported trust and skepticism toward AI content
summary: The publisher abstract reports held-evaluation accuracy of 96.67% and F1 of 93.66%. The accessible primary record does not specify sample size, recruitment or task design; results are limited to this dataset and do not establish population-level attitudes.
ai_technology: HSIC Lasso feature selection and TabNet classification modeled categories in an AI-skepticism dataset; SHAP was used for feature interpretation.
